description: File a CRM change proposal. Only a service-account (agent) key may propose; a person writes with `anyforge_update_crm_record`. The company policy decides whether it applies automatically or waits for a human decision; a change outside the agent's allowed scope is refused with `crm_scope_denied`. Repeating an `idempotencyKey` returns the original proposal. Requires `write` scope.

evidenceAt.description: Epoch ms of the newest evidence.

idempotencyKey.description: A stable key for this submission, so a retry does not file twice.

runTraceId.description: Required: the id of the agent run that produced the proposal, so a reviewer can open it.

tokensUsed.description: Tokens this submission spent, for the daily cap.

value.description: The new value: a string, number, boolean or null.

name: anyforge_submit_crm_proposal
title: Submit crm proposal
